kev_metadata.shortDescription: masterCGI in the Unified Maintenance Tool in Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise Communication Server allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

title: Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

kev_metadata.shortDescription: A vulnerability in Java deserialization used by Cisco Secure Access Control System (ACS) could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands on an affected device. The vulnerability is due to insecure deserialization of user-supplied content by the affected software.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Access Control System Java Deserialization Vulnerability

title: Cisco Secure Access Control System Java Deserialization Vulnerability

kev_metadata.notes: Please check with specific vendors (OEMs,) for information on patching status. For more information, please see: https://docs.qualcomm.com/product/publicresources/securitybulletin/june-2025-bulletin.html ;   https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-21479
kev_metadata.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain an incorrect authorization vulnerability. This vulnerability allows for memory corruption due to unauthorized command execution in GPU micronode while executing specific sequence of commands.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability

title: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability

kev_metadata.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Until the vendor releases an official fix, the following workaround should be implemented:  - Restrict User-ID Authentication Portal access to only trusted zones.  - Disable User-ID Authentication Portal if not required. 5/13/2026: Palo Alto has released a variety of patches. If these are relevant to your environment, please apply the designated patch.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the User-ID Authentication Portal (aka Captive Portal) service that can allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the PA-Series and VM-Series firewalls by sending specially crafted packets.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Out-of-bounds Write Vulnerability

title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Out-of-bounds Write Vulnerability
